messages:
maya: Kicking off observability smoke plan for the new Corsica GPU cluster (eu-corsica1). Need quick verification: logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, and alert templates. Target: minimal baseline so Dedicated can start sending traffic.

maya: Short checklist I ran locally -> please ack and add items: 1) Fluentd/Vector log collectors deployed 2) Prometheus scraping targets registered 3) Tempo/Jaeger traces ingest up 4) Dashboards copied from eu-west-1 and workspace IDs updated 5) Alert rules applied (node/gpu/pod OOMs, scraping failures, retention >30d) 6) Cost probe for expected egress/GPU hours

ops-bot: deploy: observability-stack/eu-corsica1 v1.12 started by maya at 1862507785 :rocket:

sanjay: quick network note — Corsica peering requires MTU 8960 on the GPU pool subnets, and the infra team needs to open TCP 9090, 9095, 9411 between monitoring and compute subnets. Also ensure VPC flow logs enabled for 24h during smoke.

eli: Dashboards: I copied grafana folder from eu-west-1 and updated datasource refs. Two things: change the prom endpoint to `prometheus.eu-corsica1.internal:9090` and set scrape timeout to 15s for gpu-exporter.

eli: Adding alert template for GPU memory pressure — paste below:
```
- alert: GPUHighMemoryPressure
  expr: (nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes / nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes) > 0.85
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "{{ $labels.instance }} high GPU memory usage"
    description: "GPU memory >85% for >2m on {{ $labels.instance }}. Pod: {{ $labels.pod }}"
```

maya: Thanks. Sanjay can you confirm firewall rules and whether the bastion needs an extra role for grafana datasource bootstrapping?

sanjay: Bastion only needs IAM tag `obs-bootstrap=true` and outbound to S3 for dashboard JSON imports. I'll open firewall rules now — will update when complete.

ops-bot: task: open-firewall-rules eu-corsica1 by sanjay — done at 1862508020 :white_check_mark:

maya: Ran a quick smoke: fluentd pod crashed once with `write timeout` then recovered after scaling to 3 replicas. Log snip: 
```
2026-08-03T10:12:34Z fluentd[1]: ERROR: flush thread error: write timeout (downstream)
2026-08-03T10:12:36Z kubelet: restarted container fluentd
```

eli: That suggests backend write throughput hit a burst. Increase fluentd buffer_chunks_limit from 8 -> 32 and redeploy.

maya: Doing that now -> `kubectl -n observability set env daemonset/fluentd BUFFER_CHUNKS=32`

ops-bot: deploy: fluentd-buffer-update applied at 1862508450

jamie: Cost check: if Dedicated starts sending baseline 100 GPU-hours/day, network egress ~2TB/day, estimate ~USD 18k/month for Corsica if transfer rates are similar to eu-west. We should enable cost alerts and a quota guard.

maya: Good call. Which metric should we track for quota guard?

jamie: Track `billing.estimated_egress_bytes` aggregated per-customer and an alert at 70% of soft-quota. Also add alert for `compute.gpu_hours` projected > 80% of reserved capacity.

eli: I added a lightweight alert rule for billing projection; sample rule: `predict_linear(billing_egress_bytes[6h], 24) > quota_bytes * 0.7` — tune window as needed.

maya: Can someone run the retention sanity: logs retention set to 30d in S3 lifecycle and metrics retention 90d in Thanos?

eli: Confirmed: S3 lifecycle policy applied, Thanos sidecar retention set to 90d.

ops-bot: smoke-tests: prometheus_scrape_success_rate eu-corsica1 = 99.2% (last 15m) at 1862509900

maya: Prom scrapes look good. Tempo shows traces from a sample inference job — span durations normal.

maya: Handing off to oncall for 24h watch and cost safeties. Please pick up runbook steps and escalate if alerts fire.

oncall-bot: @oncall rotation assigned to sanjay (primary) / jamie (backup) for eu-corsica1 — ack required.

sanjay: Acked. I’ll watch scrape errors and firewall anomalies.

maya: Final checklist before I close this thread: 1) Dashboard links in runbook (done) 2) Alert playbooks linked (done) 3) Cost guard in place (jamie to verify) 4) Retention & exports validated (eli done) 5) Oncall ack (sanjay)

jamie: I enabled the cost guard and set a webhook to /alerts/costs to notify finance-sro and #billing.

maya: Perfect. Thanks all — closing smoke handoff. Please add any follow-ups below. :tada:
